diagnosis: The endpoint runs a Haystack SearchQuerySet full-text query across ConfidentialContract without applying a tenant filter such as .filter(tenant_id=request.user.tenant_id). Any authenticated user can search and extract confidential contract titles and summaries across all tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/search/contracts/?q=acquisition+merger+terms HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.enterprisesearch.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
